automation.notes:
Automatic: you gain 1 Terror (tracked on your sheet, up to your Terror Capacity) when a roll you made with Edge deals attack damage, or Frightens a target through Menacing Glare or Absolute Menace, unless the target can't be Frightened. Roll Options Dialog: a Spend Terror box on your attacks adds that much damage.

Left to the table: losing all Terror when a new day starts.
